paragraphs.source_en: # Chapter Fifteen The Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF): *A Trader to the Cause?*

units.source_en: # Chapter Fifteen The Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF): *A Trader to the Cause?*

paragraphs.source_en: DURING THE PAST DECADE, the principles of the traditional index fund (TIF) have been challenged by a sort of wolf in sheep’s clothing, the exchange-traded fund (ETF). Simply put, the ETF is an index fund designed to facilitate trading in its shares, dressed in the guise of the traditional index fund.
